Enabled.description: Enable AWS services (S3, SQS, etc.) payload extraction and parsing

AttributeFamilyConfig.description: AttributeFamilyConfig maps, for a given record, each attribute with its MatchDefinition

RenameUnresolvedHosts.description:
RenameUnresolvedHosts will replace HostName and PeerName attributes when they are empty or contain
unresolved IP addresses to reduce cardinality.
Set this value to the empty string to disable this feature.

MetricSpanNameAggregationLimit.description:
MetricSpanNameAggregationLimit works PER SERVICE and only relates to span_metrics.
When the span_name cardinality surpasses this limit, the span_name will be reported as AGGREGATED.
If the value <= 0, it is disabled.

Attributes.description: Attributes configures the decoration of some extra attributes that will be added to each span

AttributesConfig.description: AttributesConfig stores the user-provided section for filtering either Application or Network records by attribute values

Buckets.description: Buckets defines the histograms bucket boundaries, and allows users to redefine them

oneOf.description: Enable all propagation methods, disable propagation, or use empty string for disabled
List of propagation methods to enable (headers/http for HTTP headers, tcp for TCP options, ip for IP options)

ContextPropagationMode.title: Context Propagation Mode
ContextPropagationMode.description: Configures distributed context propagation. Can be 'all' to enable all methods, 'disabled'/'' to disable, or a list of specific methods: 'headers' (or 'http') for HTTP headers, 'tcp' for TCP options, 'ip' for IP options.

Definitions.description: Definitions contains a list of CIDRs to be set as the "src.cidr" and "dst.cidr" attribute as a function of the source and destination IP addresses.

Services.description:
Services selection. If the user defined the OTEL_EBPF_EXECUTABLE_PATH or OTEL_EBPF_OPEN_PORT variables, they will be automatically
added to the services definition criteria, with the lowest preference.
Deprecated: Use Instrument instead

ExcludeServices.description:
ExcludeServices works analogously to Services, but the applications matching this section won't be instrumented
even if they match the Services selection.
Deprecated: Use ExcludeInstrument instead

DefaultExcludeServices.description:
DefaultExcludeServices by default prevents self-instrumentation of Beyla as well as related services (Alloy and OpenTelemetry collector)
It must be set to an empty string or a different value if self-instrumentation is desired.
Deprecated: Use DefaultExcludeInstrument instead

Instrument.description:
Instrument selects the services to instrument via Globs. If this section is set,
both the Services and ExcludeServices section is ignored.
If the user defined the OTEL_EBPF_INSTRUMENT_COMMAND or OTEL_EBPF_INSTRUMENT_PORTS variables, they will be
automatically added to the instrument criteria, with the lowest preference.

ExcludeInstrument.description:
ExcludeInstrument works analogously to Instrument, but the applications matching this section won't be instrumented
even if they match the Instrument selection.

DefaultExcludeInstrument.description:
DefaultExcludeInstrument by default prevents self-instrumentation of OBI as well as related services (Beyla, Alloy and OpenTelemetry collector)
It must be set to an empty string or a different value if self-instrumentation is desired.

PollInterval.description:
PollInterval specifies, for the poll service watcher, the interval time between
process inspections

SkipGoSpecificTracers.description: This can be enabled to use generic HTTP tracers only, no Go-specifics will be used:

BPFPidFilterOff.description: Debugging only option. Make sure the kernel side doesn't filter any PIDs, force user space filtering.

ExcludeOTelInstrumentedServices.description: Disables instrumentation of services which are already instrumented

DefaultOtlpGRPCPort.description:
DefaultOtlpGRPCPort specifies the default OTLP gRPC port (4317) to fallback on when missing environment variables on service, for
checking for grpc export requests, defaults to 4317

MinProcessAge.description: Min process age to be considered for discovery.

ExcludeOTelInstrumentedServicesSpanMetri.description: Disables generation of span metrics of services which are already instrumented

EBPFBufferSizes.description: Per-protocol data buffer size in bytes.

BpfDebug.description:
Enables loggin
g of eBPF program events

WakeupLen.description:
WakeupLen specifies how many messages need to be accumulated in the eBPF ringbuffer
before sending a wakeup request.
High values of WakeupLen could add a noticeable metric delay in services with low
requests/second.
Must be at least 0
TODO: see if there is a way to force eBPF to wakeup userspace on timeout

BatchLength.description:
BatchLength allows specifying how many traces will be batched at the initial
stage before being forwarded to the next stage
Must be at least 1

BatchTimeout.description:
BatchTimeout specifies the timeout to forward the data batch if it didn't
reach the BatchLength size

TrackRequestHeaders.description:
If enabled, the kprobes based HTTP request tracking will start tracking the request
headers to process any 'Traceparent' fields.

ContextPropagation.description:
Enables distributed context propagation.
Can be a combination of: headers, tcp, ip (e.g., "headers,tcp" or "all")

OverrideBPFLoopEnabled.description:
Skips checking the kernel version for bpf_loop functionality. Some modified kernels have this
backported prior to version 5.17.

TCBackend.description: Select the TC attachment backend: accepted values are 'tc' (netlink), and 'tcx'

DisableBlackBoxCP.description: Disables OBI black-box context propagation. Used for testing purposes only.

HighRequestVolume.description: Optimizes for getting requests information immediately when request response is seen

HeuristicSQLDetect.description:
Enables the heuristic based detection of SQL requests. This can be used to detect
talking to databases other than the ones we recognize in OBI, like Postgres and MySQL

InstrumentGPU.description: Enables GPU instrumentation for CUDA kernel launches and allocations

ProtocolDebug.description: Enables debug printing of the protocol data

UseOTelSDKForJava.description: Enables Java instrumentation with the OpenTelemetry JDK Agent

BufferSizes.description: Limit max data buffer size per protocol.

KafkaTopicUUIDCacheSize.description: Kafka Topic UUID to Name cache size.

PayloadExtraction.description: Configure data extraction/parsing based on protocol

MaxTransactionTime.description:
Maximum time allowed for two requests to be correlated as parent -> child
Some programs (e.g. load generators) keep on generating requests from the same thread in perpetuity,
which can generate very large traces. We want to mark the parent trace as invalid if this happens.

DNSRequestTimeout.description: DNS timeout after which we report failed event

Enabled.description: Enable Elasticsearch payload extraction and parsing

ExportModes.description: ExportModes specifies which signals are going to be exported for a given service, via the public methods CanExportTraces and CanExportMetrics.

GlobAttr.description: GlobAttr provides a YAML handler for glob.Glob so the type can be parsed from YAML or environment variables

Name.description:
Name will define a name for the matching service. If unset, it will take the name of the executable process,
from the OTEL_SERVICE_NAME env var of the instrumented process, or from other metadata like Kubernetes annotations.
Deprecated: Name should be set in the instrumentation target via kube metadata or standard env vars.
To be kept undocumented until we remove it.

Namespace.description:
Namespace will define a namespace for the matching service. If unset, it will be left empty.
Deprecated: Namespace should be set in the instrumentation target via kube metadata or standard env vars.
To be kept undocumented until we remove it.

OpenPorts.description:
OpenPorts allows defining a group of ports that this service could open. It accepts a comma-separated
list of port numbers (e.g. 80) and port ranges (e.g. 8080-8089)

Path.description: Path allows defining the regular expression matching the full executable path.

Metadata.description: Metadata stores other attributes, such as Kubernetes object metadata

PodLabels.description: PodLabels allows matching against the labels of a pod

PodAnnotations.description: PodAnnotations allows matching against the annotations of a pod

ContainersOnly.description: ContainersOnly restricts the discovery to processes which are running inside a container

ExportModes.description:
Configures what to export. Allowed values are 'metrics', 'traces',
or an empty array (disabled). An unspecified value (nil) will use the
default configuration value

GlobDefinitionCriteria.description: GlobDefinitionCriteria allows defining a group of services to be instrumented according to a set of attributes.

Enabled.description: Enable GraphQL payload extraction and parsing

Override.description: Override allows overriding the reported host.id in OBI

FetchTimeout.description: FetchTimeout specifies the timeout for trying to fetch the HostID from diverse Cloud Providers

Include.description:
Include is a list of metric attributes that have to be reported. It can be an attribute
name or a wildcard (e.g. k8s.dst.* to include all the attributes starting with k8s.dst).
If no include list is provided, the default attribute set will be reported.

Exclude.description:
Exclude will remove attributes from the include list (or the default attribute set).
It can be an attribute name or a wildcard.

HostnameDNSResolution.description:
HostnameDNSResolution is true if OBI uses the DNS to resolve the local hostname or
false if it uses the local hostname.

OverrideHostname.description:
OverrideHostname can be optionally set to avoid resolving any hostname and using this
value. OBI will anyway attach the process ID to the given hostname for composing
the instance ID.

InstanceIDConfig.description: InstanceIDConfig configures how OBI will get the Instance ID of the traces/metrics from the current hostname + the instrumented process PID

InternalMetricsConfig.description: InternalMetricsConfig options for the different metrics exporters

ClusterName.description:
ClusterName overrides cluster name. If empty, the NetO11y module will try to retrieve
it from the Cloud Provider Metadata (EC2, GCP and Azure), and leave it empty if it fails to.

KubeconfigPath.description: KubeconfigPath is optional. If unset, it will look in the usual location.

InformersResyncPeriod.description: InformersResyncPeriod defaults to 30m. Higher values will reduce the load on the Kube API.

DropExternal.description:
DropExternal will drop, in NetO11y component, any flow where the source or destination
IPs are not matched to any kubernetes entity, assuming they are cluster-external

DisableInformers.description:
DisableInformers allows selectively disabling some informers. Accepted value is a list
that might contain node or service. Disabling any of them
will cause metadata to be incomplete but will reduce the load of the Kube API.
Pods informer can't be disabled. For that purpose, you should disable the whole
kubernetes metadata decoration.

MetaCacheAddress.description: MetaCacheAddress is the host:port address of the beyla-k8s-cache service instance

MetaRestrictLocalNode.description:
MetaRestrictLocalNode will download only the metadata from the Pods that are located in the same
node as the Beyla instance. It will also restrict the Node information to the local node.

MetaSourceLabels.description:
MetaSourceLabels allows Beyla overriding the service name and namespace of an application from
the given labels.
Deprecated: kept for backwards-compatibility with Beyla 1.9

ResourceLabels.description: ResourceLabels allows Beyla overriding the OTEL Resource attributes from a map of user-defined labels.

ServiceNameTemplate.description: ServiceNameTemplate allows to override the service.name with a custom value. Uses the go template language.

Match.description: Match stores the glob that a given attribute must match to let the record pass

NotMatch.description: NotMatch stores the glob that a given attribute MUST NOT match to let the record pass

MatchDefinition.description: MatchDefinition stores the user-provided definition for the record filtering.

MetaSourceLabels.description: MetaSourceLabels allow overriding some metadata from kubernetes labels Deprecated.

OTELIntervalMS.description:
OTELIntervalMS supports metric intervals as specified by the standard OTEL definition.
OTEL_EBPF_METRICS_INTERVAL takes precedence over it.

InsecureSkipVerify.description: InsecureSkipVerify is not standard, so we don't follow the same naming convention

SDKLogLevel.description:
SDKLogLevel works independently from the global LogLevel because it prints GBs of logs in Debug mode
and the Info messages leak internal details that are not usually valuable for the final user.

Features.description:
Features of metrics that can be exported. Accepted values: application, network, application_process,
application_span, application_service_graph, ...
envDefault is provided to avoid breaking changes

Instrumentations.description: Allows configuration of which instrumentations should be enabled, e.g. http, grpc, sql...

TTL.description:
TTL is the time since a metric was updated for the last time until it is
removed from the metrics set.

OTLPEndpointProvider.description:
OTLPEndpointProvider allows overriding the OTLP Endpoint. It needs to return an endpoint and
a boolean indicating if the endpoint is common for both traces and metrics

InjectHeaders.description: InjectHeaders allows injecting custom headers to the HTTP OTLP exporter

ExtraSpanResourceLabels.description:
ExtraSpanResourceLabels adds extra metadata labels to OTEL span metrics from sources whose availability can't be known
beforehand. For example, to add the OTEL deployment.environment resource attribute as a OTEL resource attribute,
you should add `deployment.environment`.

Sources.description: Sources for name resolving. Accepted values: dns, k8s

CacheLen.description:
CacheLen specifies the max size of the LRU cache that is checked before
performing the name lookup. Default: 256

CacheTTL.description:
CacheTTL specifies the time-to-live of a cached IP->hostname entry. After the
cached entry becomes older than this time, the IP->hostname entry will be looked
up again.

Enable.description:
Enable network metrics.
Default value is false (disabled)
Deprecated: add "network" to OTEL_EBPF_METRIC_FEATURES or OTEL_EBPF_PROMETHEUS_FEATURES
TODO OBI 3.0: remove

Source.description:
Specify the source type for network events, e.g tc or socket_filter. The tc implementation
cannot be used when there are other tc eBPF probes, e.g. Cilium CNI.

AgentIP.description: AgentIP allows overriding the reported Agent IP address on each flow.

AgentIPIface.description:
AgentIPIface specifies which interface should the agent pick the IP address from in order to
report it in the AgentIP field on each flow. Accepted values are: external (default), local,
or name:<interface name> (e.g. name:eth0).
If the AgentIP configuration property is set, this property has no effect.

AgentIPType.description:
AgentIPType specifies which type of IP address (IPv4 or IPv6 or any) should the agent report
in the AgentID field of each flow. Accepted values are: any (default), ipv4, ipv6.
If the AgentIP configuration property is set, this property has no effect.

Interfaces.description:
Interfaces contains the interface names from where flows will be collected. If empty, the agent
will fetch all the interfaces in the system, excepting the ones listed in ExcludeInterfaces.
If an entry is enclosed by slashes (e.g. `/br-/`), it will match as regular expression,
otherwise it will be matched as a case-sensitive string.

ExcludeInterfaces.description:
ExcludeInterfaces contains the interface names that will be excluded from flow tracing. Default:
"lo" (loopback).
If an entry is enclosed by slashes (e.g. `/br-/`), it will match as regular expression,
otherwise it will be matched as a case-sensitive string.

Protocols.description: Protocols causes OBI to drop flows whose transport protocol is not in this list.

ExcludeProtocols.description:
ExcludeProtocols causes OBI to drop flows whose transport protocol is in this list.
If the Protocols list is already defined, ExcludeProtocols has no effect.

CacheMaxFlows.description:
CacheMaxFlows specifies how many flows can be accumulated in the accounting cache before
being flushed for its later export. Default value is 5000.
Decrease it if you see the "received message larger than max" error in OBI logs.

CacheActiveTimeout.description:
CacheActiveTimeout specifies the maximum duration that flows are kept in the accounting
cache before being flushed for its later export.

Deduper.description:
Deduper specifies the deduper type. Accepted values are "none" (disabled) and "first_come".
When enabled, it will detect duplicate flows (flows that have been detected e.g. through
both the physical and a virtual interface).
"first_come" will forward only flows from the first interface the flows are received from.
Default value: first_come

DeduperFCTTL.description:
DeduperFCTTL specifies the expiry duration of the flows "first_come" deduplicator. After
a flow hasn't been received for that expiry time, the deduplicator forgets it. That means
that a flow from a connection that has been inactive during that period could be forwarded
again from a different interface.
If the value is not set, it will default to 2 * CacheActiveTimeout

Direction.description:
Direction allows selecting which flows to trace according to its direction. Accepted values
are "ingress", "egress" or "both" (default).

Sampling.description:
Sampling holds the rate at which packets should be sampled and sent to the target collector.
E.g. if set to 100, one out of 100 packets, on average, will be sent to the target collector.

ListenInterfaces.description:
ListenInterfaces specifies the mechanism used by the agent to listen for added or removed
network interfaces. Accepted values are "watch" (default) or "poll".
If the value is "watch", interfaces are traced immediately after they are created. This is
the recommended setting for most configurations. "poll" value is a fallback mechanism that
periodically queries the current network interfaces (frequency specified by ListenPollPeriod).

ListenPollPeriod.description:
ListenPollPeriod specifies the periodicity to query the network interfaces when the
ListenInterfaces value is set to "poll".

ReverseDNS.description:
ReverseDNS allows flows that haven't been previously decorated with any source/destination name
to override the name with the network hostname of the source and destination IPs.
This is an experimental feature and it is not guaranteed to work on most virtualized environments
for external traffic.

Print.description: Print the network flows in the Standard Output, if true

CIDRs.description:
CIDRs list, to be set as the "src.cidr" and "dst.cidr"
attribute as a function of the source and destination IP addresses.
If an IP does not match any address here, the attributes won't be set.
If an IP matches multiple CIDR definitions, the flow will be decorated with the
narrowest CIDR. By this reason, you can safely add a 0.0.0.0/0 entry to group there
all the traffic that does not match any of the other CIDRs.

PortEnum.description: PortEnum defines an enumeration of ports.

End.description: if End == 0, it means this entry is not a port range but a single port

Features.description:
Features of metrics that can be exported. Accepted values: application, network, application_process,
application_span, application_service_graph, ...

Instrumentations.description: Allows configuration of which instrumentations should be enabled, e.g. http, grpc, sql...

TTL.description:
TTL is the time since a metric was updated for the last time until it is
removed from the metrics set.

Registry.description:
Registry is only used for embedding Beyla within the Grafana Agent.
It must be nil when Beyla runs as standalone

ExtraResourceLabels.description:
ExtraResourceLabels adds extra metadata labels to Prometheus metrics from sources whose availability can't be known
beforehand. For example, to add the OTEL deployment.environment resource attribute as a Prometheus resource attribute,
you should add `deployment.environment`.

ExtraSpanResourceLabels.description:
ExtraSpanResourceLabels adds extra metadata labels to Prometheus span metrics from sources whose availability can't be known
beforehand. For example, to add the OTEL deployment.environment resource attribute as a Prometheus resource attribute,
you should add `deployment.environment`.

RegexDefinitionCriteria.description: RegexDefinitionCriteria allows defining a group of services to be instrumented according to a set of attributes.

Name.description:
Name will define a name for the matching service. If unset, it will take the name of the executable process,
from the OTEL_SERVICE_NAME env var of the instrumented process, or from other metadata like Kubernetes annotations.
Deprecated: Name should be set in the instrumentation target via kube metadata or standard env vars.
To be kept undocumented until we remove it.

Namespace.description:
Namespace will define a namespace for the matching service. If unset, it will be left empty.
Deprecated: Namespace should be set in the instrumentation target via kube metadata or standard env vars.
To be kept undocumented until we remove it.

OpenPorts.description:
OpenPorts allows defining a group of ports that this service could open. It accepts a comma-separated
list of port numbers (e.g. 80) and port ranges (e.g. 8080-8089)

Path.description: Path allows defining the regular expression matching the full executable path.

PathRegexp.description:
PathRegexp is deprecated but kept here for backwards compatibility with Beyla 1.0.x.
Deprecated. Please use Path (exe_path YAML attribute)

Metadata.description: Metadata stores other attributes, such as Kubernetes object metadata

PodLabels.description: PodLabels allows matching against the labels of a pod

PodAnnotations.description: PodAnnotations allows matching against the annotations of a pod

ContainersOnly.description: Restrict the discovery to processes which are running inside a container

ExportModes.description:
Configures what to export. Allowed values are 'metrics', 'traces',
or an empty array (disabled). An unspecified value (nil) will use the
default configuration value

RegexSelector.description: RegexSelector that specify a given instrumented service.

RegexpAttr.description: RegexpAttr stores a regular expression representing an executable file path.

Type.description: Type of ReverseDNS. Values are "none" (default), "local" and "ebpf"

CacheLen.description:
CacheLen only applies to the "local" and "ebpf" ReverseDNS type. It
specifies the max size of the LRU cache that is checked before
performing the name lookup. Default: 256

CacheTTL.description:
CacheTTL only applies to the "local" and "ebpf" ReverseDNS type. It
specifies the time-to-live of a cached IP->hostname entry. After the
cached entry becomes older than this time, the IP->hostname entry will be looked
up again.

Unmatch.description: Unmatch specifies what to do when a route pattern is not matched

Patterns.description: Patterns of the paths that will match to a route

IgnorePatterns.description: Deprecated. To be removed and replaced by a collector-like filtering mechanism

IgnoredEvents.description: Deprecated. To be removed and replaced by a collector-like filtering mechanism

WildcardChar.description: Character that will be used to replace route segments

MaxPathSegmentCardinality.description: Max allowed path segment cardinality (per service) for the heuristic matcher

RoutesConfig.description: RoutesConfig allows grouping URLs sharing a given pattern.

SamplerConfig.description: Sampler standard configuration https://opentelemetry.io/docs/concepts/sdk-configuration/general-sdk-configuration/#otel_traces_sampler We don't support, yet, the jaeger and xray samplers.

Selection.description: Selection specifies which attributes are allowed for each metric.

Instrumentations.description: Allows configuration of which instrumentations should be enabled, e.g. http, grpc, sql...

InsecureSkipVerify.description: InsecureSkipVerify is not standard, so we don't follow the same naming convention

MaxQueueSize.description:
Configuration options below this line will remain undocumented at the moment,
but can be useful for performance-tuning of some customers.

BackOffInitialInterval.description:
Configuration options for BackOffConfig of the traces exporter.
See https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/blob/main/config/configretry/backoff.go
BackOffInitialInterval the time to wait after the first failure before retrying.

BackOffMaxInterval.description: BackOffMaxInterval is the upper bound on backoff interval.

BackOffMaxElapsedTime.description: BackOffMaxElapsedTime is the maximum amount of time (including retries) spent trying to send a request/batch.

SDKLogLevel.description:
SDKLogLevel works independently from the global LogLevel because it prints GBs of logs in Debug mode
and the Info messages leak internal details that are not usually valuable for the final user.

OTLPEndpointProvider.description:
OTLPEndpointProvider allows overriding the OTLP Endpoint. It needs to return an endpoint and
a boolean indicating if the endpoint is common for both traces and metrics

InjectHeaders.description: InjectHeaders allows injecting custom headers to the HTTP OTLP exporter

NetworkFlows.description: NetworkFlows configuration for Network Observability feature

Routes.description: Routes is an optional node. If not set, data will be directly forwarded to exporters.

Exec.description:
Exec allows selecting the instrumented executable whose complete path contains the Exec value.
Deprecated: Use OTEL_EBPF_AUTO_TARGET_EXE

AutoTargetExe.description:
AutoTargetExe selects the executable to instrument matching a Glob against the executable path.
To set this value via YAML, use discovery > instrument.
It also accepts OTEL_GO_AUTO_TARGET_EXE for compatibility with opentelemetry-go-instrumentation

Port.description:
Port allows selecting the instrumented executable that owns the Port value. If this value is set (and
different to zero), the value of the Exec property won't take effect.
It's important to emphasize that if your process opens multiple HTTP/GRPC ports, the auto-instrumenter
will instrument all the service calls in all the ports, not only the port specified here.

ServiceName.description:
ServiceName is taken from either OTEL_EBPF_SERVICE_NAME env var or OTEL_SERVICE_NAME (for OTEL spec compatibility)
Using env and envDefault is a trick to get the value either from one of either variables.
Deprecated: Service name should be set in the instrumentation target (env vars, kube metadata...)
as this is a reminiscence of past times when we only supported one executable per instance.

ServiceNamespace.description:
Deprecated: Service namespace should be set in the instrumentation target (env vars, kube metadata...)
as this is a reminiscence of past times when we only supported one executable per instance.

EnforceSysCaps.description:
Check for required system capabilities and bail if they are not
present. If set to 'false', OBI will still print a list of missing
capabilities, but the execution will continue

LogConfig.description: format of the log configuration during startup

title: OBI Configuration Schema
description: JSON Schema for OpenTelemetry eBPF Instrumentation (OBI) configuration
